name: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Ltd
about: Tata Motors Group is a global automobile manufacturer. Part of the multi-national conglomerate, the Tata group, it offers a wide and diverse portfolio of cars, sports utility vehicles, etc. It has operations in India, the UK, South Korea, South Africa, China, Brazil, Austria and Slovakia through a strong global network of subsidiaries, associate companies and Joint Ventures (JVs), including Jaguar Land Rover in the UK and TMCV 40% stack [1]
pros: Stock is trading at 0.94 times its book value
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 52.4%
cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 6.08% over past five years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -3.88%
